def test_golden_cuj_f5(tmp_path):
    """
    Format F5 Golden CUJ (Full Custom Video):
    100% Stock Online (STOCK_ONLINE). Zero AI images, zero AI video.
    """
    story_dir = tmp_path / "f5_story"
    work_dir = story_dir / "work"
    story_dir.mkdir(parents=True)

    audio_path = _create_synthetic_audio(story_dir / "audio.m4a", duration=3.0)
    ass_path = _create_synthetic_ass(story_dir / "subtitles.ass")
    s1 = _create_synthetic_video(story_dir / "stock_01.mp4", duration=1.5, color="maroon")
    s2 = _create_synthetic_video(story_dir / "stock_02.mp4", duration=1.5, color="olive")

    plan = create_default_format_plan(FormatId.F5)
    segments = [
        VisualSegment(0, 0.0, 1.5, "stock", s1, description="F5 Stock Scene 1", source_class=SourceClass.STOCK_ONLINE, asset_id="f5_s1"),
        VisualSegment(1, 1.5, 1.5, "stock", s2, description="F5 Stock Scene 2", source_class=SourceClass.STOCK_ONLINE, asset_id="f5_s2")
    ]
    sched = TimelineSchedule(story_dir=story_dir, audio_path=audio_path, total_duration=3.0, segments=segments)

    # 1. Format grammar validation
    val = FormatValidator.validate_timeline(sched.segments, plan)
    assert val["valid"] is True
    assert val["format"] == "F5"

    # 2. Editorial QC Gate
    qc_res = EditorialQC.evaluate_timeline(sched.segments, sched.total_duration, plan, min_shot_duration=1.0)
    assert qc_res.verdict == EditorialVerdict.PASS

    # 3. Master NVENC Render
    engine = NvencRenderEngine(work_dir=work_dir)
    out_master = story_dir / "f5_master.mp4"
    metrics = engine.render_master_video(sched, ass_path, out_master, format="f5", format_plan=plan)

    # 4. Stream QA Verification
    meta = QAVerifier.inspect_stream_metadata(out_master)
    assert meta["width"] == 1920
    assert meta["height"] == 1080
    assert abs(meta["fps"] - 30.0) < 0.1
    assert meta["video_codec"] == "h264"
    assert meta["duration"] >= 2.8

    # 5. RunManifest & Secrets Verification
    _verify_manifest_and_secrets(out_master.parent / "run_manifest.json", out_master)

Shots with the same long script but different visual directions can therefore receive the same search. The filter also checks forbidden visuals only in a candidate’s title, and the fit reason gives a score without naming what matches.
